high_level_description: The image depicts a person sitting inside the driver's seat of a vintage white car. The individual is wearing a dark green leather jacket with a distinctive white and red design on the left shoulder. They have long, dark hair and are resting their head on their hand, which is placed near their cheek, giving a relaxed and contemplative expression. The person appears to be looking out of the car window, which is partially open. The car itself has a classic design, featuring chrome accents on the door handle and side mirror.
